correctness.rationale: For all integer p>=2 and q>=3, bases and exchange edges identify exactly with edges and edge incidence of H=K_q join independent p-set. The signless incidence Gram formula L=D-B^TB is verified; disjoint subspaces of dimensions (p-1)(q-1), p-1, q(q-3)/2, 2(q-1), and 2 exhaust E. Their spectral factors are respectively T, S, U, W, and t(t-2p-q+1). Kirchhoff multiplication yields the integer tree formula. The exact symbolic relation W(S)=q-p(p-1) and strict comparison of all remaining factors prove the connectivity threshold and exact multiplicities; no enumeration hypothesis is used. The packaged independent basis-enumeration checker passes exact characteristic polynomial and cofactor checks on seven parameter pairs plus symbolic discriminant/threshold identities. Limits: finite checks corroborate only; the algebraic proof is the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The strongest relevant prior universal formulas already cover the tree-count function implicitly; that component alone is not claimed independently new. The narrower combined finding gives the explicitly evaluated entire Laplacian spectrum and a nonlinear clique-contrast vs parallel-class-contrast Fiedler eigenspace transition for the full natural two-parameter base-polytope family. Original matroid-polytope source specifies the graph, not the spectrum; full-text Dong–Yan universal counting formula has no spectral factorization; analogous split-graph signless spectral work concerns a different matrix. Remaining access/naming risks noted and not hidden.
residual_risks: An equivalent all-parameter line-graph spectral factorization might appear in publications under different notation for split/threshold/complete multipartite graphs.

value.rationale: Natural complete all-parameter Laplacian classification of a two-parameter rank-two matroid-polytope graph family, including explicit multiplicities and an exact nonlinear Fiedler eigenspace exchange at q=p(p-1), offers structural information not encoded in the underlying graph reconstruction or general implicit tree-count identities. The graph changes from clique-contrast to independent-class-contrast controlling connectivity, with an exactly quantified equality multiplicity. The evaluated integer product is a substantive efficient companion invariant. It is not a small arbitrary isolated computation, renaming, or routine normalization.
